title: v4 verdict: NO-WIN — hard task (H≈50×W) but graph didn't collapse hardness; recorded knowledge too general/mismatched. Loop NOT wired.
summary: v4-hard (n=5 opus, 10/10 solved). The task design SUCCEEDED at creating hardness: H_off=18,682 vs W_off=374 → H≈50×W (precondition PASS, fairness PASS, corroboration W_on/W_off=1.08 PASS). BUT the graph did NOT help: H_on=18,214 ≈ H_off=18,682 (diff 468, pooled stdev 18,666 → pure noise). ON paid C=19,084 consult overhead on top → METRIC=(H_off−H_on)×5−C = −16,744 → margin FAIL → NO-WIN. WHY (diagnosed from transcripts): every ON arm called get_learnings exactly once, NONE expanded via get_task_detail; the recorded verdict (token-a 'read-side time-window correlation' beat token-b) is TOPICALLY related but does NOT contain the precise case-3-vs-case-4 session-cardinality rule the fixed test enforces — so even consulting it, ON had to re-derive the specific rule the hard way, same as OFF. THIRD DISTINCT NULL completing the map of when the orchestrator helps: v1 = agent doesn't consult (no benefit, ~free); v2/v3 = task too easy → zero hardness to save; v4 = task genuinely hard + agent consults, but recorded knowledge too GENERAL/MISMATCHED to collapse the specific hardness (and lean index too thin to recognize/expand). UNIFYING LESSON: the orchestrator saves hardness ONLY when the graph holds the PRECISE prior resolution to the exact sub-problem AND it's surfaced specifically enough to recognize+apply — i.e. the COMPOUNDING-MEMORY regime (you solved THIS before, recorded the actual answer, now recall it), not 'a related verdict exists'. DECISION: do NOT wire the autonomous loop (T21) to hunt for a winning single-task — it would either keep nulling or converge on RIGGING (hand-feeding the exact answer to ON = not a fair test). The checkpoint gave us the answer the loop would have burned a large budget to find. The only legitimate remaining test is v4b: genuine compounding memory — solve a problem, record the ACTUAL solution as a verdict, then give a fresh agent the SAME problem and measure whether recalling its own prior resolution collapses hardness NET of overhead.
